paperTitle: Hybrid Rendering for Dynamic Scene Reflections
centralContribution: This work presents a hybrid rendering approach combining Screen Space Reflections (SSR) and GPU ray tracing to generate fast and realistic reflections in highly dynamic scenes involving both rigid and deformable body simulations. The central contribution is a custom CUDA-based ray tracing component, accelerated by a Linear Bounding Volume Hierarchy (LBVH), which demonstrates superior efficiency and scalability compared to a previous OptiX-based implementation, achieving interactive frame rates and higher visual quality for complex, dynamic geometries.

units.title: Dynamic Reflection Problem
units.summary: Challenges of real-time, artifact-free reflections in dynamic scenes.

content.description: The core challenge of generating accurate, artifact-free, and efficient reflections for real-time applications, especially in highly dynamic scenes with rigid and deformable body simulations. Existing methods struggle with visual artifacts and performance in these complex environments.
